subject: PO vs Card - procurement next steps / onboarding
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Samir Shah <samir.shah@finopsco.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up: procurement path & next steps (PO vs card)

Hi Samir, thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can get procurement moving.

Summary of what I heard:
- Primary use case: product recommendation API for search relevance (pilot).
- Expected spend first 12 months: ~$85k (monthly ramp).
- AP preference: you mentioned a PO process for purchases over $10k and a vendor onboarding window of ~10 business days.

Questions / asks:
1) Will FinOpsCo proceed via Purchase Order (PO) or corporate card for the pilot? If PO, is a standard PO + invoice workflow required (we can invoice monthly against PO)?
2) Who is the procurement/vendor onboarding owner so we can share the onboarding checklist and W9?
3) Any marketplace requirements (AWS/GCP marketplace) or do you prefer direct vendor setup?

Next steps I propose:
- I'll attach a mutual action plan and our vendor onboarding checklist. Please confirm PO vs card and procurement contact and I'll kick off onboarding.
- If PO, we can issue an initial invoice on net 30 against the PO. If card, we'll provide an invoice for your records.

Attachments: Redwood_Mutual_Action_Plan.xlsx, vendor_onboarding_checklist.pdf

Thanks, happy to jump on a quick call with procurement if helpful.

-- Marissa
Marissa Cole | Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: Samir Shah <samir.shah@finopsco.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@finopsco.com>
Date: Fri, 19 Jun 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up: procurement path & next steps (PO vs card)

Thanks Marissa, good summary. A few clarifications from AP/procurement side:

- FinOpsCo policy: purchases above $10k need a PO and vendor onboarding. Pilot looks like it will exceed that threshold once we ramp.
- Vendor onboarding timeline: roughly 7-10 business days after we receive W9 + VAT form (if applicable) + insurance certs.
- Preferred payment: PO + monthly invoice (net 30). We can process card for one-off purchases under $5k but we prefer PO for anything recurring or above threshold.

Procurement owner: procurement@finopsco.com (cc'd), they'll need your standard W9, vendor contact, remittance address, and our vendor onboarding form filled out.

Marketplace: we generally prefer direct vendor onboarding for SSO and entitlements; marketplace billing introduces extra internal approvals. If you're in AWS Marketplace and can support private offers, that's an option but not required for this pilot.

Also: does Redwood accept invoice references to PO numbers and provide invoice PDF with line-level charges? That speeds our AP matching.


-- Samir
Finance Lead, FinOpsCo
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Date: Mon, 22 Jun 2026 08:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up: procurement path & next steps (PO vs card)

Hi Samir / procurement team, great, thanks for the clarity. Quick answers:

- We support PO + invoice (we can include the PO number on the invoice and provide a line-item breakdown monthly). Invoices are PDF and emailed to the remittance contact you provide.
- Vendor docs: I've attached our vendor_onboarding_checklist.pdf in case procurement wants to see typical items; we can provide W9/insurance certs immediately.
- Marketplace: understood, we'll plan for direct vendor onboarding for this pilot. If the team later wants AWS Marketplace private offers, we can explore that in parallel (longer timeline).

Proposed next steps:
1) Procurement: please confirm the remittance address and the contact who will approve the vendor record (procurement@finopsco.com is fine).
2) I'll send W9 and the MSA for signature via DocuSign (link below). If legal needs redlines, please share, we can turn around basic redlines quickly.
3) Once vendor is approved, we can finalize the initial PO and start the pilot.

DocuSign MSA: https://www.docusign.com/envelope/ABC12345
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/45872

If useful, I'm happy to do a 15-min call with procurement to walk through the onboarding checklist.

Best,
Marissa
